sources.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report (Bai et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Three upgrades: interleaved-MRoPE (spatial-temporal modeling), DeepStack multi-level ViT features for tighter VL alignment, text-based time alignment evolving T-RoPE to explicit textual timestamps for precise temporal grounding; 256K native interleaved context (books, hours-long video, full recall, second-level indexing); dense 2B-32B + MoE 30B-A3B/235B-A22B; Instruct + Thinking editions.
claims.context: Full-paper abstract + repo README key-enhancements section; architecture claims from first-party report.

claims.text: Three pillars: stronger pure-text understanding (beats text-only backbones in cases); 256K long-context retention/retrieval/cross-referencing; leading MMMU/visual-math reasoning; sqrt-reweighting protects text while boosting multimodal.
claims.context: Abstract pillars consumed; all vendor-measured — quarantined, not adopted as independent fact.

claims.text: Deployment surface (repo-verified): Dense+MoE edge-to-cloud, FP8 variants, Transformers/vLLM support; Visual Agent GUI operation; 2D + 3D grounding; context expandable 1M per repo.
claims.context: Qwen3-VL README consumed; deployment facts, not architecture.

limitations.text: All benchmark claims vendor-measured (G05); token/config figures config-bound (CV2-DM-020); independent reproduction pending; repo commit binding at later stages.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
